image_reading_erratum: An initial low-resolution reading confused GPIO6 pin19 NC with MODE2 pin18 NC. Enlarged original vector PDF proves MODE2 is connected. Correct address is 0x4D. No mode defect or address0x4F claim is retained.
header_3V3_erratum: P1.1/17 have a separate 3V3 label in this exact schematic; active DAC supply is VCC from U6. No 3V3-to-VCC connection is shown. Leave these header pins unconnected. Earlier parallel-regulator-output reasoning was not proven.
